name: phoenix-admin-node
description: Phoenix Admin Host Node.js backend maintained from Cool Admin Midway 8.x

scripts.dev: rimraf src/index.ts && cool check && node scripts/pah-sync-runtime-entities.cjs && cross-env NODE_ENV=local PAH_DEV_DISABLE_CAPTCHA=true mwtsc -p .runtime/tsconfig.phoenix.json --cleanOutDir --watch --run ./scripts/dev-midway4.js --keepalive
scripts.dev:midway4: rimraf src/index.ts && node scripts/pah-sync-runtime-entities.cjs && cross-env NODE_ENV=midway4 mwtsc -p .runtime/tsconfig.phoenix.json --cleanOutDir --watch --run ./scripts/dev-midway4.js --keepalive
scripts.dev:plugin-installer: pnpm run build && cross-env NODE_ENV=production PAH_LOCAL_PACKAGE_MODE=true PAH_DB_SYNCHRONIZE=false PAH_DB_INITIALIZE=false node bootstrap.js
scripts.verify: pnpm run lint && pnpm run test:ci && pnpm run build
scripts.verify:midway4: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:ci && pnpm run build && pnpm run test:midway4
scripts.build: pnpm run entities:sync && node scripts/pah-bundle-runtime.cjs && mwtsc -p .runtime/tsconfig.phoenix.json --cleanOutDir && node scripts/copy-pah-plugin-artifacts.mjs
scripts.build:obfuscate: pnpm run entities:sync && node scripts/pah-bundle-runtime.cjs && mwtsc -p .runtime/tsconfig.phoenix.json --cleanOutDir && node scripts/copy-pah-plugin-artifacts.mjs && cool obfuscate
scripts.pkg: rimraf build && mkdir build && npm run build && pkg . -d > build/pkg.log
scripts.pm2:stop: pm2 stop phoenix-admin-node & pm2 delete phoenix-admin-node

author: COOL
